methodology: OpenAI and Anthropic are both private -- neither files with the SEC, so none of the standardized quarterly pipeline (companies.json, the 11-tab company view) applies to them. This file holds manually curated public facts only: each company's own on-the-record statements (basis REAL) and, separately, figures leaked to press or disclosed only to investors that the company has not confirmed publicly (basis REPORTED). Not part of the automated daily SEC refresh -- these numbers move on each company's own disclosure schedule (funding rounds, blog posts), not a fetchable API.
